name: <i>Watchword, The</i>
title: <i>Watchword, The</i>
---

This periodical, the privately printed journal of the Society of Watchers and Workers, ran 1880-1972; the BL has only odd volumes, but there is an almost complete run in Lambeth Palace Library. The BL\'s copies are bound with interesting rolls of members of the society; CMY is listed as a member of the executive committee. Christina Rossetti was also a member. The Watchword was initially edited by the society’s founder [Edith Jacob](/person/749) (1836-1918).
